subject: Whistic evidence: encryption controls + KMS rotation for Apex Therapeutics
messages:
From: Matt Lane <matt.lane@whistic.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: security@apextherapeutics.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: encryption proof + KMS rotation cadence for Apex Therapeutics Whistic profile

Hi Irene / Neha,

Quick one — Apex's security team is doing a focused review of our Whistic profile and they asked us to upload specific evidence around encryption at rest and key management. They're asking for:

- A copy of your KMS key rotation policy (how often keys are rotated, who approves rotations)
- An architecture diagram showing where customer data is encrypted (S3 buckets, ephemeral caches, etc.)
- Any SOC 2 / encryption-related control references or artifact IDs

Can you confirm whether Redwood can upload these files to the Whistic record (linked below) or if you prefer us to accept attachments and upload on your behalf? Apex would like the evidence in place by end of week (11/26) to keep their procurement timeline.

Whistic record: https://app.whistic.com/portal/records/AXP-9237

Thanks,
Matt Lane
Partner Success — Whistic

[Attachment: sample_whistic_upload_instructions.pdf]

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>

Matt — thanks for the heads up.

Neha, can you own preparing the artifacts below? I think we can upload directly to the Whistic record, but confirm access scope first (I don't want keys or secrets in the upload — just policies/diagrams). Please reference Apex's scoped questions: they expect a policy PDF and a simple diagram.

Copying Aditya for any approvals around publication of the KMS policy (aditya, if we need to redact anything sensitive let Neha know).

Irene

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 08:05:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Request: encryption proof + KMS rotation cadence for Apex Therapeutics Whistic profile

Irene — I pulled together the docs and uploaded a first pass to our secure drive. Summary below: 

1) redwood-kms-rotation-policy-2026.pdf (attached) — public-facing policy with rotation cadence (90 days for CMKs used for customer data), roles (Security Ops approves rotation; Platform Infra executes), and an anonymized change log. We redacted internal runbook step IDs.

2) s3-encryption-architecture-diagram.png (attached) — shows S3 bucket boundaries, which services write encrypted payloads, and where KMS CMKs are referenced. Diagram uses high-level icons only.

3) References in SOC2: control ID INF-EN-03 (encryption of data at rest). I included the SOC2 evidence tag and a pointer to the SOC2 SOC report location (we cannot attach the full SOC here per policy; we gave the file ID to Apex for their auditor access).

I attempted to upload directly into Whistic but hit a permissions error (Whistic requires a portal user with upload rights). Matt from Whistic: can you either grant redwood_upload@redwood.ai upload permission to record AXP-9237, or confirm that Whistic support will accept the attachments and put them into the record on our behalf?

Next steps:
- If upload rights are granted, I'll push the two files and add the policy summary text to the Whistic Q&A entry.
- If Whistic uploads on our behalf, send me confirmation and I'll mark the task done.

Neha Kapoor
Trust & Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai

[Attachment: redwood-kms-rotation-policy-2026.pdf]
[Attachment: s3-encryption-architecture-diagram.png]

Hi Matt / Apex team —

Thanks for the patience. Neha and I coordinated and we have uploaded the requested artifacts to the Whistic record for Apex (AXP-9237). Summary of what was added:

- redwood-kms-rotation-policy-2026.pdf — policy document (redactions noted inside).
- s3-encryption-architecture-diagram.png — high-level architecture diagram.
- SOC2 reference: INF-EN-03 tag added to the Whistic evidence entry with pointer to auditor-access-only report (per our data-sharing policy).

Whistic upload: https://app.whistic.com/portal/records/AXP-9237 (you should see the new evidence items under "Uploaded Files"). Matt, please confirm the record shows the attachments and let us know if Apex needs any additional metadata (original file hashes, uploader id, or a signed statement).

Aditya — if Apex requests a signed attestation, I will escalate; otherwise we provided the standard policy statement.

Irene Choi
